name: Self-Employment / Business Permit (Third-Country)

application_window.note: Subject to the same third-country federal quota as ch_third_country_work_permit

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being in the overall economic interest of Switzerland — genuine demand, job creation, investment, innovation, market need — with a mandatory business plan/budgeted balance sheet.
requirements.fix_path: Develop a business plan demonstrating economic interest.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires adequate seed capital and expected income sufficient to cover operating and living costs, plus available business premises.

evidence_required.document: Business plan and budgeted balance sheet

sources.title: Self-employment - State Secretariat for Migration (Art. 19 FNIA)

notes: Genuinely quota-limited (Art. 19 FNIA), subject to the SAME third-country federal quota as ch_third_country_work_permit rather than a separate business-specific allocation — a real structural constraint distinct from most other countries' self-employment routes in this dataset, which typically run outside the numerical caps that apply to standard employer-sponsored work. Passive ownership of a Swiss AG/GmbH confers NO residence permit on its own — the business must independently pass the economic-interest test, a real and often-underestimated gate worth flagging.
